claim.claim-text: a cannula, wherein the cannula comprises a distal tip, an elongated tubular shaft, and an inner lumen formed by the elongated tubular shaft; and a light detector, wherein the light detector is disposed within the inner lumen of the cannula.
2. The cannula locator device of claim 1, wherein the light detector is movable past the distal tip of the cannula to guide a catheter into vasculature of a patient.

3. The cannula locator device of claim 1, wherein the light detector comprises a camera coupled with one or more sheathed electrical cables, wherein the camera is disposed at least proximate the distal tip of the cannula, wherein the one or more sheathed electrical cables extend through the inner lumen of the cannula.
4. The cannula locator device of claim 3, wherein the camera is spaced apart from an inner wall of the elongated tubular shaft.
5. The cannula locator device of claim 1, further comprising:

a first optical fiber disposed within the inner lumen of the cannula, wherein the first optical fiber comprises a first distal end and a first proximal end, wherein the first optical fiber is configured to emit light, wherein the light detector comprises second optical fibers, wherein each of the second optical fibers comprise a second distal end and a second proximal end, wherein the proximal ends of each of the second optical fibers are coupled with a camera, wherein the second optical fibers are configured to receive reflected light, wherein the camera is configured to generate an image.
6. The cannula locator device of claim 5, wherein the first and second distal ends are disposed at least proximate the distal tip of the cannula.
7. The cannula locator device of claim 6, wherein the first and second optical fibers are spaced apart from an inner wall of the elongated tubular shaft.
8. The cannula locator device of claim 1, further comprising:

a first optical fiber disposed within the inner lumen of the cannula, wherein the first optical fiber comprises a first distal end and a first proximal end, wherein the first optical fiber is configured to emit light, wherein the light detector comprises a second optical fiber disposed within the inner lumen of the cannula, wherein the second optical fiber comprises a second distal end and a second proximal end, wherein the second optical fiber is configured to detect reflected light, wherein the proximal end of the second optical fiber is coupled with a wavelength detector, wherein the wavelength detector is configured to convert the reflected light into an electrical signal, wherein the wavelength detector is coupled with a signal processor, wherein the signal processor is configured to determine a color of the reflected light.
9. The cannula locator device of claim 8, further comprising:

a catheter adapter comprising a catheter; and a needle shield coupled with the catheter adapter, wherein the distal tip of the cannula and the first and second distal ends are configured to be retracted into the needle shield.
